insight.burden-mark-adept.why: Burden Mark limit +1; optional 5-foot step once per round after spending, same surface, no OA from the bearer.

TAL_EARTH_BURDEN_THE_FLYING_THING.why: Optional native Strength save: descend 30/10 feet and forbid altitude gain for the printed duration. Nonnative permission, exemption and lateral-surface cases remain explicit.
